# Loading the Models
```{r}
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(MLmetrics)
library(ROCR)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(tidyr)

# Load best models
best_tree <- readRDS("best_tree.rds")
best_xgb  <- readRDS("best_xgb.rds")
best_rf   <- readRDS("best_random_forest.rds")

# Load predictions data frame (contains Actuals, _prob, _class for each model)
tree_preds <- readRDS("tree_preds.rds")
holdout_trees = readRDS("holdout_trees.rds")
df_trees_balanced = readRDS("df_trees_balanced.rds")

holdout_trees$home_ownership <- as.character(holdout_trees$home_ownership)
holdout_trees$home_ownership[holdout_trees$home_ownership == "ANY"] <- "OTHER"
holdout_trees$home_ownership <- factor(holdout_trees$home_ownership)


# Make predictions
tree_preds$rf_class <- predict(best_rf, holdout_trees, type = "class")
tree_preds$rf_prob  <- predict(best_rf, holdout_trees, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

```


# comparing F1
```{r}
get_manual_metrics <- function(pred_class, pred_prob, actual, model_name) {
cm <- confusionMatrix(
factor(pred_class, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
factor(actual, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
positive = "Yes"
)

F1_val <- MLmetrics::F1_Score(y_pred = as.character(pred_class),
y_true = as.character(actual),
positive = "Yes")
AUC_val <- pROC::auc(ifelse(actual == "Yes", 1, 0),
as.numeric(pred_prob),
direction = "<")

data.frame(
Model = model_name,
Accuracy = round(cm$overall["Accuracy"], 4),
Recall = round(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4),
Precision = round(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"], 4),
F1 = round(F1_val, 4),
Balanced_Accuracy = round(cm$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"], 4),
Detection_Rate = round(cm$byClass["Detection Rate"], 4),
AUC = round(as.numeric(AUC_val), 4)
)
}

metrics_tree <- get_manual_metrics(tree_preds$Tree4_class, tree_preds$Tree4_prob, tree_preds$Actuals, "Decision Tree")
metrics_rf   <- get_manual_metrics(tree_preds$rf_class,   tree_preds$rf_prob,   tree_preds$Actuals, "Random Forest")
metrics_xgb  <- get_manual_metrics(tree_preds$xgb6_class,  tree_preds$xgb6_prob,  tree_preds$Actuals, "XGBoost")

model_comparison <- rbind(metrics_tree, metrics_rf, metrics_xgb) 
model_comparison



```


# comparing ROC
```{r}
pred_Tree = ROCR::prediction(tree_preds$Tree4_prob,
                              tree_preds$Actuals)
roc_Tree = ROCR::performance(pred_Tree,"tpr", "fpr")

pred_rf = ROCR::prediction(tree_preds$rf_prob,
                            tree_preds$Actuals)
roc_rf = ROCR::performance(pred_rf,"tpr", "fpr")

pred_xgb = ROCR::prediction(tree_preds$xgb6_prob,
                            tree_preds$Actuals)
roc_xgb = ROCR::performance(pred_xgb,"tpr", "fpr")


plot(roc_Tree, col = "blue", lwd = 2 , main = "ROC Curves")
plot(roc_rf, col = "green", lwd = 2 , add = TRUE)
plot(roc_xgb, col = "orange", lwd = 2 , add = TRUE)

abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

```

# Comparing AUC
```{r}
auc_tree <- ROCR::performance(pred_Tree, "auc")@y.values[[1]]
auc_rf <- ROCR::performance(pred_rf, "auc")@y.values[[1]]
auc_xgb <- ROCR::performance(pred_xgb, "auc")@y.values[[1]]

cat("\nAUC Comparison:\n",
sprintf("Decision Tree: %.4f\n", auc_tree),
sprintf("Random Forest: %.4f\n", auc_rf),
sprintf("XGBoost: %.4f\n", auc_xgb))

```

```{r}
metrics_long <- model_comparison %>%
select(Model, F1, AUC, Accuracy, Recall, Precision) %>%
pivot_longer(-Model, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(metrics_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 3)), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "darkgreen", "orange")) +
labs(title = "Model Comparison – Performance Metrics", y = "Score", x = "") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 13)



```
